body.title: Integrate design review latest-subject preparation
body.summary: Route subject capture, planning/impact/chunks and explicit recovery through same lifecycle with design-specific latest target/ancestry checks. Deliver private adapters consumed by existing coordinator/worker dependency seams and exercise them in focused integration fixtures. Production runtime selection is activated only in the coordinated t12 cutover after host and lifecycle dependencies exist.
acceptanceChecks: Through the shared family adapter, DEF/HLD/LLD route matrix passes; relevant target changes invalidate and await human restart; unrelated edits ignored; prompts use paths, not artifact bodies.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

This task gates the complete family adapter and its focused tests, not default production selection. It must expose execution/recovery seams for t9/t12; full production activation is mandatory in t12 and independently qualified in t13. No feature flag, parallel review engine or incomplete production cutover.

tests.name: Extend design subject-monitor/recovery tests: latest DEF/HLD/LLD routes, impact/chunk reuse, target invalidation/user restart and unrelated edit stability.
